Tamil Nadu Launches Free Health Insurance for Seniors

Tamil Nadu has launched a new Chief Minister's free health insurance scheme targeting residents aged 70 and above. The scheme aims to cover 38 lakh people in this age group. The initiative provides free health insurance to all residents meeting the age criteria.
